Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2020
ACT II OF 2020
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Provincial Motor Vehicles
Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
29th January, 2020]
NO. PAS
/ LEGIS-B-01/2020, dated 29.1.2020.---
The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 08th January, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 17th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965

The Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 08th January, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 17th January, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Provincial
Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 2 of the West Pakistan Ordinance No. XIX of 1965.---In the Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance,
1965, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, for clause
(4), the following shall be substituted:-
"(4)
"certificate of registration" means and includes the Security
Featured Motor Vehicle Registration (MVR) Smart Card issued by the competent
authority to effect that a motor vehicle has been registered in accordance with
the provisions of Chapter-III;".
